driverFormulas.rev: Revenue = Gross Sales − OSP Adjustments & Discounts
driverFormulas.cogs: Cost of Sales = Purchases & Royalties + Producing Personnel + Operations, Refining & Transport
driverFormulas.gp: Gross Profit = Revenue − Cost of Sales
driverFormulas.gp-pct: Gross Margin % = Gross Profit / Revenue x 100
driverFormulas.opex-excl: Operating Expenses = Selling & Distribution + Exploration + General & Administrative
driverFormulas.da: Depreciation, Depletion & Amortisation = Producing Assets + Facilities + Intangibles
driverFormulas.nonop: Finance & Other Income = Finance Income − Finance Costs + Other
driverFormulas.ebt: Income Before Income Taxes & Zakat = EBIT + Finance & Other
driverFormulas.ni: Net Income = Income Before Tax − Taxes & Zakat
driverFormulas.ni-pct: Net Income Margin % = Net Income / Revenue x 100
driverFormulas.bs-assets: Total Assets = Current Assets + Non-Current Assets
driverFormulas.bs-ca: Current Assets = Cash + Receivables + Inventories + Prepaids
driverFormulas.bs-inv: Inventories = Crude + In-Process + Refined Products & Polymers
driverFormulas.bs-nca: Non-Current Assets = PP&E + Accum. DD&A + Intangibles + Investments
driverFormulas.bs-liab-eq: Total Liabilities & Equity = Current Liabilities + Non-Current Liabilities + Equity
driverFormulas.bs-cl: Current Liabilities = Payables + Accruals + ST Debt + Royalties & Taxes Payable
driverFormulas.bs-ncl: Non-Current Liabilities = Bonds & Sukuk + Deferred Tax + Provisions
driverFormulas.bs-equity: Equity = Share Capital + Retained Earnings + OCI
driverFormulas.cfo: Cash Flow from Operating Activities = Net Income + DD&A + Working Capital
driverFormulas.cfi: Cash Flow from Investing Activities = CapEx + Disposals + Acquisitions
driverFormulas.cff: Cash Flow from Financing Activities = Borrowings + Equity + Dividends
driverFormulas.cf-net: Net Change in Cash = CFO + CFI + CFF
driverFormulas.cf-end-cash: Ending Cash = Net Change + Beginning Cash
